Composition & Indication

Venlafaxine ER 75mg — 30 Capsules (Generic for Effexor®) contains Venlafaxine Hydrochloride 75 mg (extended release) as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Capsules at the official 75mg ER strength. The standard indication is the management of depression and anxiety disorders, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Venlafaxine ER 75mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
